title: Mock mapper ordering — specific suffix before generic alias
trigger: Jest config có generic alias + specific suffix mappers (?raw, ?worker)
principle: Jest moduleNameMapper thử patterns theo declaration order — first match wins. Generic alias (^@/(.*)$) match mọi path kể cả path có Vite suffix (?raw, ?worker, ?url). Specific suffix mappers phải declared trước generic alias, hoặc chúng unreachable → ENOENT vì file system lookup bao gồm suffix trong filename.

cases.context: Thêm ?raw imports vào source file, Jest test fail ENOENT
cases.bad: const moduleNameMapper = { '^@/(.*)$': '<rootDir>/src/$1', '\\?raw$': '<rootDir>/tests/rawMock.ts' }; // generic match trước → ?raw never reached → ENOENT
cases.good: const moduleNameMapper = { '\\?raw$': '<rootDir>/tests/rawMock.ts', '^@/(.*)$': '<rootDir>/src/$1' }; // specific trước → ?raw match → rawMock.ts

applyFor: Bất kỳ moduleNameMapper có generic alias + specific suffix mappers
Webpack resolveLoader alias ordering (same first-match-wins semantics)
